gbifID.description: Global Biodiversity Information Facility unique record identifier for each occurrence.

datasetKey.description: Uniform dataset identifier linking all records to the same GBIF dataset.

occurrenceID.description: Unique iNaturalist observation URLs linking to individual Haritalodes derogata records.

kingdom.description: Taxonomic kingdom classification for each record, always Animalia.

phylum.description: Phylum classification for all records is Arthropoda.

class.description: Taxonomic class of the organism is Insecta.

order.description: Taxonomic order of the recorded species, consistently Lepidoptera.

family.description: Taxonomic family of the species, consistently Crambidae across all records.

genus.description: Genus of the recorded species, consistently Haritalodes across all records.

species.description: Species name of the recorded organism, consistently Haritalodes derogata.

infraspecificEpithet.description: Infraspecific epithet data is unavailable for all records.

taxonRank.description: Taxonomic rank consistently recorded as species for all occurrence records.

scientificName.description: Scientific name of the recorded moth species.

verbatimScientificName.description: Scientific name of the recorded moth species, either Haritalodes derogata or Haritalodes obliqualis.

verbatimScientificNameAuthorship.description: Authorship information for the scientific name is unavailable.

countryCode.description: Country codes follow ISO 3166‑1 alpha‑2 standard for occurrence records.

locality.description: Locality information is missing for all records.

stateProvince.description: Subnational region (state or province) where each species occurrence was recorded.

occurrenceStatus.description: Occurrence status is recorded as present for all records.

individualCount.description: Individual count data missing for all records.

publishingOrgKey.description: Identifier of the organization that published the occurrence record.

decimalLatitude.description: Geographic latitude in decimal degrees for each occurrence record.

decimalLongitude.description: Geographic longitude of observation recorded in decimal degrees.

coordinateUncertaintyInMeters.description: Spatial uncertainty of occurrence coordinates measured in meters.

coordinatePrecision.description: Coordinate precision is missing for every occurrence record.

elevation.description: Elevation data is missing for all records.

elevationAccuracy.description: Elevation accuracy data missing for all records.

depth.description: Depth information is missing for all records.

depthAccuracy.description: Depth accuracy information is unavailable for all records.

eventDate.description: Date and time of each occurrence event.

day.description: Day of month when the observation was recorded.

taxonKey.description: Taxon identifier codes distinguishing two species-level groups within the dataset.

speciesKey.description: Unique species identifier code for Haritalodes derogata occurrence records.

basisOfRecord.description: Record source type, uniformly recorded as human observation.

institutionCode.description: Institution code identifying iNaturalist as the data source for all records.

collectionCode.description: All records share the collection identifier “Observations”.

catalogNumber.description: Unique numeric identifier for each occurrence record.

recordNumber.description: No data available for this identifier field.

identifiedBy.description: Names of individuals who identified each occurrence record.

dateIdentified.description: Identification timestamp of each occurrence record.

license.description: Data usage license applied to each occurrence record.

rightsHolder.description: Names of individuals or entities holding copyright for each occurrence record.

recordedBy.description: Names of individuals or entities who documented each occurrence record.

typeStatus.description: No recorded type status information for any occurrence.

establishmentMeans.description: Establishment means data unavailable for all records.

lastInterpreted.description: Timestamp of last data interpretation for each occurrence record.

mediaType.description: Media type of occurrence record, indicating format of associated media.

issue.description: Issue codes flag data problems like coordinate rounding, continent derivation, and missing taxon ID.

haritalodes_derogata.description: 1001 Haritalodes derogata occurrence records (2008‑2026) with taxonomy, location, date, and observer metadata.

description: Contains 1001 occurrence records of a species spanning 2008‑2026 for biodiversity monitoring.
